create_photo_consistency_loss: create a PhotoConsistencyLoss module to compute color distance between warped target and reference images
use_rectified_photo_consistency_loss: use RectifiedPhotoConsistencyLoss to compute photo consistency for rectified stereo image pairs with baseline and sign metadata
compute_l1_distance: compute the L1 distance by summing absolute values along a specified dimension of a tensor
compute_mae_distance: compute the mean absolute error along a specified dimension of a tensor
compute_rmse_distance: compute the RMSE by taking the L2 norm along a specified dimension of a tensor
